no_actionable_improvement: latest 12 completed successful docs.yml runs in the last 14 days again provided sufficient evidence, including 10 comparable build executions and 8 schedule-triggered runs. Trusted docs metadata showed median full workflow wall time 64.5s with p90 91.3s, median build queue 13.0s with p90 16.1s, median build execution 48.5s with p90 54.7s, median schedule-freshness execution 8.0s with p90 9.3s on schedule runs, and median deploy execution 12.0s with p90 18.5s on the 6 runs that actually deployed. Comparable build-step medians remained 12.5s for Build documentation, 6.5s for Restore node_modules, 2.0s for Restore cached CAO Dashboard, and 9.0s for Upload Pages artifact. Trusted logs for representative docs run 36857708421 confirmed repeated cache hits for actions/setup-node npm cache, the explicit node_modules cache, and the central-agentic-ops-dashboard cache; Install dependencies, Save node_modules, Find latest CAO Dashboard run, and Mount latest CAO Dashboard artifact stayed skipped whenever build executed. In the current scheduling/concurrency/avoidable-rebuilds category, schedule-freshness already skipped 2 of the 8 successful scheduled runs in this sample at about 11-12s total and the remaining workflow_run executions tracked new successful cao-dashboard producer runs rather than duplicate same-SHA rebuilds worth >=60s on their own. Cross-checking the latest 5 successful cao-dashboard.yml producer runs still showed the dominant repeated upstream cost is reusable-dashboard cache preparation, with Upgrade fallback activity data taking 77s median and 84.4s p90 while Assemble Dashboard Language site stayed at 4.0s median and Upload dashboard artifact at 6.0s median; bounded trusted logs for run 36853340265 also confirmed that producer still recopied a validated 420.1 MiB gh-aw-logs.sqlite plus 114 activity shards totaling 266.3 MiB into the dashboard artifact before upload. That reusable-dashboard bottleneck remains the only repeated qualifying optimization, but it is already represented by suggestion fingerprint reusable-dashboard-skip-reupgrade-of-validated-activity-cache in repository memory and open issues #15332 and #15497, so no new non-duplicate recommendation is actionable in this scheduling/concurrency/avoidable-rebuilds cycle.
